children: On November 5, 2025, Duolingo reported that daily active user growth slowed to 36%, compared with 49% in the first quarter and 40% in the second quarter. Management also announced that Duolingo would prioritize user growth over monetization. Following this news, Duolingo stock fell $66.28 per share, or approximately 25%, to close at $193.74 per share on November 6, 2025.

On January 12, 2026, Duolingo announced its Chief Financial Officer's resignation and preliminary fourth-quarter figures showing daily active user growth of approximately 30%. Following this news, the stock fell $14.92 per share, or 8.45%, to close at $161.74 per share that day.

On February 26, 2026, after the market closed, Duolingo projected 2026 daily active user growth of 20% and bookings growth of 10% to 12%. Management acknowledged that its monetization efforts had introduced friction that it knew would cause users to leave and slow user growth. Following this news, the stock fell $16.45 per share, or approximately 14%, to close at $101.00 per share on February 27, 2026.
